music.prompt: Urgent ticking tension at 120 BPM at full volume from the very first beat, no quiet intro: fast staccato pizzicato strings, a ticking clock, a pulsing muted kick and building hi-hats, like a countdown before a big moment, rising to the end. No vocals.

Groovy nu-disco track at 120 BPM that starts immediately at full energy and full volume on the very first beat, with no quiet intro, no build-up and no fade-in: four-on-the-floor disco drums, a funky octave bass line, chopped rhythm guitar, lush disco strings and bright synth stabs. Confident and upbeat, like a modern product launch. Full energy all the way through with no breakdown and no big ending hit. No vocals, no singing.
